nq1474770.title: Novo raises full-year outlook on continued GLP-1 momentum, with third-quarter adjusted operating profit increasing 27% at CER to DKK 31,720 million

results.text: Q3 2026 adjusted and reported sales increased by 4% at CER, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across the US and International operations, primarily in obesity.

Q3 2026 adjusted operating profit increased by 27% at CER, driven by GLP-1 sales growth and a favourable comparison base following DKK 9 billion of company-wide transformation costs recognised in Q3 2025.

Q3 2026 reported operating profit decreased by 9% at CER, reflecting DKK 8.7 billion of non-cash impairment charges in the quarter, related to ziltivekimab (DKK 4.6 billion) and right-sizing of manufacturing network (DKK 4.1 billion).
Reported sales in Q3 2026 increased by 6% measured in Danish kroner and by 4% at CER, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across geographies, particularly in obesity.
Reported sales in 9M 2026 increased by 11% measured in Danish kroner and by 13% at CER, driven by GLP-1.
Q3 2026 adjusted sales increased by 4% at CER to DKK 79,195 million, driven by GLP-1 volume growth in both operating units, partly offset by lower realised prices.

outlook.text: Adjusted sales growth for 2026 is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER and adjusted operating profit growth is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER.

events: By the end of Q3, Wegovy® pill had been launched in the US, UAE, UK and Germany, with uptake driving Q3 2026 sales of DKK 5,394 million. More recently, launches in four additional countries increased the total number of launched markets to eight.

Ozempic® pill was launched in the US in May, with encouraging early momentum. Weekly new-to-brand prescriptions (NBRx) are currently up around 100% compared with pre-launch levels under the Rybelsus® brand.
sections.outlook: Adjusted sales growth for 2026 is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER and adjusted operating profit growth is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER. The improved outlook is driven by increased expectations for GLP-1 product sales.

results.text: Operative EBIT decreased to EUR -1.7 million (EUR 0.2 million), -2.6% of revenue (0.2%).
As investment in public charging slowed sharply, our order intake decreased by 19% and revenue by 10%.
Against this backdrop, our revenue grew 12% in January–September.
In Q3, while new public DC fast charging installations in Europe declined 22%, our European revenue declined 5%, and in Europe outside the Nordics it grew 10%.
In the Nordics, revenue decreased 30% as existing customers moderated investments.
Aftermarket revenue grew 83% in Q3 and 60% in January–September, and represented 8% of Q3 revenue, double the share of a year ago.

outlook.text: The new outlook is as follows: 2026 revenue is expected to grow approximately 5% compared to year 2025, assuming no major impact from foreign currency exchange rates (revenue 2025: EUR 251.3 million). 2026 operative EBIT is expected to be lower compared to year 2025 (operative EBIT 2025: EUR -12.4 million).
The updated financial targets are: Revenue growth: 15-25% CAGR over 2025–2030, in constant currency, range based on different market growth scenarios.
With an order backlog of EUR 128 million (9% higher than a year ago) and liquidity of EUR 91 million, we have the backlog and balance sheet to deliver.

nq1474734.title: INTERIM REPORT OF MARIMEKKO, 1 Jan-30 Sept 2026: Marimekko's net sales and operating profit increased in the third quarter due to the excellent development of international sales

results.text: The third quarter in brief Marimekko’s net sales in the third quarter increased by 3 percent and amounted to EUR 52.1 million (50.8).
Net sales in Finland decreased by 9 percent as especially wholesale sales declined in the continued challenging operating environment.
International sales increased by 16 percent following the excellent development of net sales in all market areas.
Comparable operating profit totaled EUR 13.0 million (12.7) equaling to 25.0 percent of net sales (24.9).
Net sales in Finland decreased by 6 percent as the continued challenging market situation impacted negatively particularly domestic retail sales.
Comparable operating profit totaled EUR 23.4 million (23.5) equaling to 17.0 percent of net sales (17.5).

outlook.text: Financial guidance for 2026 (unchanged) The Marimekko Group’s net sales for 2026 are expected to grow from the previous year (2025: EUR 189.6 million).

Our financial guidance for 2026 remains unchanged: the Marimekko Group’s net sales for 2026 are expected to grow from the previous year, and the comparable operating profit margin is estimated to be approximately some 16–19 percent.

highlights: Marimekko’s net sales in the third quarter increased by 3 percent and amounted to EUR 52.1 million (50.8). Net sales were boosted especially by the excellent development of wholesale and retail sales in all international market areas.

Net sales in Finland decreased by 9 percent as especially wholesale sales declined in the continued challenging operating environment. In a price-sensitive market situation, retail sales in Finland also decreased.
International sales increased by 16 percent following the excellent development of net sales in all market areas.
sections.outlook: International sales are estimated to grow in 2026. In addition, net sales in the Asia-Pacific region, Marimekko’s second-largest market area, are expected to increase. All brick-and-mortar Marimekko stores and most online stores in Asia are partner-owned. In 2026, the aim is to open approximately 15–20 new Marimekko stores and shop-in-shops, and most of the planned openings will be in Asia.
